normalization: feature and target mean/std fit on training split only

replacement.exact_learned_parameter_matching: component-wise=256*h; composed=256*h at every grid point

exploration_rationale_for_lock.provisional_nmse_0.08: too strict: neither topology reached a passing endpoint on any exploration seed
exploration_rationale_for_lock.nmse_0.12: chosen before confirmatory runs because all three exploration component-wise curves reached 0.104-0.115 by h=24 while composed reached <=0.12 at smaller widths; threshold is shared by both conditions
exploration_rationale_for_lock.r2_tolerance_0.05: retained from the provisional rule; exploration replacement R2 values remained within this tolerance at the relevant high-fidelity endpoints
exploration_rationale_for_lock.grid_extension: h=20 improves resolution between 16 and 24; h=32 is a preregistered ceiling guard so a confirmatory component-wise endpoint slightly above exploration does not become silently censored

primary_endpoint: paired log2(B_composed / B_componentwise) at minimum validation-passing learned-replacement budget

primary_decision_rule.coverage: both endpoints must exist for all 8 confirmatory seeds for VALID_PASS or VALID_FAIL
pass_if: composed budget is strictly lower in at least 7 of 8 seeds
paired seed-bootstrap 95% CI upper bound for mean log2 budget ratio is < 0
primary_decision_rule.valid_fail_if: all 8 seeds have both endpoints but one or more PASS criteria fail
primary_decision_rule.valid_inconclusive_censoring_if: one or more seeds lack either passing endpoint on the locked grid; such seeds are retained and not dropped

secondary: one-sided exact sign test on non-tied comparable seeds
selected-endpoint test R2 difference, composed minus component-wise

interpretation_boundary: A PASS supports this operational effect for one built-in tabular regression dataset and this residual-MLP/replacement protocol. It does not establish universal regression, task-universal, grammar-independent, or mathematical complexity subadditivity.
stopping_rule: Run seeds 2200-2207 exactly once under this locked protocol. Do not tune thresholds, grid, teacher training, or map updates after viewing outcomes. Any revision is a new protocol version and cannot replace this result.
